summary: The Read Restrictions Sync notes for 15 September 2026 are an agenda of five questions with no recorded answers. They ask whether to create a GitHub project for read restrictions and break the work into smaller tickets; seek volunteers for the PyIceberg and Iceberg Rust implementations, with an issue for each; propose Iceberg 1.13 as the target for the Actions API and REST scaffolding; cover trust enablement through mTLS in the SDK and a possible ticket for token exchange in the Auth Manager; and ask whether the sync is still needed or mailing list updates are enough.

topics.title: GitHub project for read restrictions
topics.summary: The notes ask whether to create a GitHub project for read restrictions under apache/iceberg, with the work broken into smaller tickets. No answer is recorded.
open_questions: Should a GitHub project be created for read restrictions?

topics.title: Volunteers for PyIceberg and Iceberg Rust
topics.summary: The notes ask for volunteers to implement read restrictions in PyIceberg and Iceberg Rust, and link a tracking issue in each repository.

topics.title: SDK target for the Actions API and REST scaffolding
topics.summary: The notes propose Apache Iceberg 1.13 as the target for the Actions API and REST scaffolding, with a question mark. The stated benefits are that it enables parallel development in JVM-based engines and enables JVM-based Iceberg REST servers.
open_questions: Is Iceberg 1.13 the SDK target for the Actions API and REST scaffolding?

topics.title: Trust enablement
topics.summary: Two items on establishing trust: mTLS in the SDK, with a pull request linked, and whether to file a ticket for token exchange in the Auth Manager, or whether the auth manager v2 proposal already handles it. The notes link the token exchange documentation of dremio/iceberg-auth-manager.
open_questions: Should a ticket be filed for token exchange in the Auth Manager, or does the auth manager v2 proposal cover it?

topics.title: Future of the sync
topics.summary: The notes ask whether the sync is still needed or whether updates on the mailing list are enough. No answer is recorded.
open_questions: Is the sync still needed, or should updates go to the mailing list?
